title: offer
description: An offer, at the path `offer/<id>`. It names no market or role: those are its author profile's, and the role says whether it offers (a seller) or asks (a buyer). Markets may add fields.

remote.description: Optional. True when the work happens online.

media.description: Optional. Photos and short videos of the work.

expires.description: Optional. After this the offer is stale.

price.description: The price block. Optional. Per item, hour, day, month or job: the app multiplies before funding, one escrow per payment.

amount.description: Amount in whole units of the token, as decimal text: "25", "12.50".

mint.description: The token, named by its mint's address on Solana, base58. Any token the escrow takes; which tokens an index weighs is the index's call.

per.description: What one amount buys: one item, an hour, a day, a month, or the whole job.

terms.description: Optional. The options an escrow made from this offer is created with, each off unless set. Absent or empty: no arbiter and no timer.

arbiter.description: Optional. A Solana key, base58, that may decide any split. Absent: no arbiter.

timer.description: Optional. This many days after funding, everything goes to the named side. The only clock an escrow has.

to.description: The side that gets everything when the timer ends.

location.description: Optional. Where: a point the app rounds to precisionKm before writing, and the place in words. Degrees are decimal text, since a record holds no fractional numbers.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees, -90 to 90, as decimal text with at most 4 decimals: "38.72".

lon.description: Longitude in degrees, -180 to 180, as decimal text with at most 4 decimals: "-9.14".

precisionKm.description: How far, in whole kilometres, the point may be from the real place: the app rounds the point to this before writing. 0 is an exact point, for a shop or a venue.

area.description: The place in words: a neighbourhood, a town.

media.description: A photo or a short video, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

mimeType.description: The file's media type, type/subtype in lower case, such as image/jpeg. Which types to take is each host's own choice, and each reader's.

size.description: Bytes. How large a blob to take is each host's own choice, and each reader's.
